newsitem.title: CHINA: Bank of China renames investment arm.
newsitem.headline: Bank of China renames investment arm.

text.p: The Bank of China Trust & Consultancy Co, the investment arm of the Bank of China, has changed its name to China Orient Trust & Investment Co, the bank said on Thursday.
The trust firm had a registered local capital of 300 million yuan ($36.1 million) and foreign capital of $100 million, said a bank announcement in the China Daily newspaper.
The name change was made on March 6 in line with an order from the People's Bank of China, the central bank, the announcement said.
Beijing is moving to separate trust firms affiliated with China's four main state banks from their financial backers to reduce risks to the banks.
The name change would not affect the the firm's status as a state-run investment company, the announcement said but gave no further details.
